title: The guided path: step 1, My data
intro: The path begins with the data of the site. Each tab shows a bar above its content with the step, its purpose, and the buttons Back and Next. The tabs can still be opened in any order from the row of tabs; the bar only shows where the tab lies on the path.

marks.d: Step 1 of 11. The first step has no Back button.
